items.title: 68099_Erskine Hawkins oral history interview
items.q: It just opened again with James Earl Jones this time.

ctx.x: Right. I haven't had a chance to go see a show like that in years. I remember the last time I was at one of the theaters, I caught Othello. Paul Robeson. Now, that's been a few years. You know. I've been working. I've been going in. I'm just waiting for the time I can get off, you know, and go into the theater and catch some of those good things.
Right. It just opened again with James Earl Jones this time. Right?
Right. Now, you can see how long since I've been there. I saw Othello then with Paul Robeson. That's a few years. I won't say a lot of years. I just say a few.
